title: Synthesis, characterization, and adsorptive removal of methyl blue using combustion-synthesized Al4B2O9 and Al5BO9
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,30662-30675
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01929C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Uğur Özkan, Okan Bayram, Emel Moral, İlhan Pekgözlü, Fethiye Göde
This study investigates the removal process of methyl blue (MeB), an anionic dye, using synthesized Al4B2O9 and Al5BO9 as adsorbent materials. Al4B2O9 and Al5BO9 were synthesized via the combustion method.
